faq.q: hat do I bring on my Kona fishing trip?
faq.a: You bring your own food, drinks & sunscreen. We will supply ice, fishing rods, fishing reels and all gear and tackle. We can hook you up with your food and drinks for the day from our Bite Me Fish Market Bar and Grill. What can we catch in Kona waters? We fish for Black Marlin, Blue Marlin, Striped Marlin, Short Nosed Spearfish, Ahi, Ono, Wahoo, Mahimahi, Yellowfin Tuna, Skip Jack Tuna, Big Eye Tuna, Rainbow Runners, and sometimes we catch sharks, too.
